localAdditions.reason: Superflux added these with the verifier on 2026-08-03. They are not in upstream stop-slop, so an upstream review must keep them, not drop them.

localOverrides.localRule: Remove adverbs that add no meaning. Keep one when it states an important condition, timing, or degree.
localOverrides.reason: A blanket ban removes useful engineering distinctions and can make prose unnatural.

localOverrides.localRule: Use punctuation that makes the sentence easy to read. Reject repeated dramatic em dashes, not the character itself.
localOverrides.reason: Punctuation is not slop by itself. Rhythm and clarity decide whether it belongs.

localOverrides.localRule: Use the number of items the source actually contains. Group or layer long lists when the reader cannot retain them.
localOverrides.reason: Artificially cutting a real three-part set loses information.

localOverrides.upstreamRule: Every sentence needs a human subject
localOverrides.localRule: Name the real actor, including a service, page, job, or person. Do not assign human motives to software.
localOverrides.reason: Engineering explanations often need software components as literal actors.

localOverrides.upstreamRule: Sentence starts with a Wh- word
localOverrides.localRule: Remove rhetorical questions and repeated formulaic openings. Keep a Wh- opening when it is the clearest direct question.
localOverrides.reason: Grammar alone does not determine whether a sentence is AI slop.
